changeSet.author: business-team
changeSet.sql: UPDATE ${currency.table} cr SET effective_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ${temp.table} tr WHERE cr.currency_code = tr.currency_code AND cr.effective_to IS NULL AND ( cr.rate != tr.rate OR cr.decimals != tr.decimals OR cr.description != tr.description );

INSERT INTO ${currency.table} (currency_code, rate, decimals, description, created_by_deployment_version, effective_from) SELECT tr.currency_code, tr.rate, tr.decimals, tr.description, tr.is_active, tr.created_by_deployment_version, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ${temp.table} tr JOIN ${currency.table} cr ON cr.currency_code = tr.currency_code WHERE cr.effective_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

INSERT INTO ${currency.table} (currency_code, rate, decimals, description, is_active, created_by_deployment_version, effective_from) SELECT tr.currency_code, tr.rate, tr.decimals, tr.description, tr.is_active, tr.created_by_deployment_version, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM ${temp.table} tr WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${currency.table} cr WHERE cr.currency_code = tr.currency_code );

UPDATE ${currency.table} cr SET effective_to = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, is_active = false WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${temp.table} tr WHERE tr.currency_code = cr.currency_code ) AND cr.effective_to IS NULL;
CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmp_execution_time AS SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP as exec_time;
